title: [3.x] Visual Server memory leak on Android device

milestone.title: 3.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 3 release.

body:
### Tested versions

- reproduced: v3.6.stable.official [de2f0f147]
- not: v3.5.3.stable.official [6c814135b]
- not: v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Xiaomi Redmi 5 Plus, Android 8.1, Adreno 506

### Issue description

Found `VisualServer` memory leak introduced between **3.6** and **3.5.2** versions

### Steps to reproduce

0. start logcat with
```
adb logcat -s godot
```

2. make project, add button with following script

```gdscript
extends Button


func _on_quit() -> void:
	get_tree().quit()


func _ready() -> void:
	connect("button_down", self, "_on_quit")
```

2. disable **auto accept quit** and **quit on go back** in ProjectSettings
3. export project to android device
4. press button
5. watch logcat output
